name: hvcorca
description: A free and open-source Roblox script hub

scripts.bundle: npm run compile && npm run build && node -e "const d=new Date();console.log('🔥 Release v'+d.toISOString().replace(/[-:T]/g,'').slice(0,13))" && remodel run ci/bundle.lua public/latest.lua v1.1.4 minify && remodel run ci/bundle.lua public/latest.debug.lua v1.1.4 debug
scripts.bundle:dbg: npm run compile && npm run build && remodel run ci/bundle.lua public/latest.debug.lua v1.1.4 debug
scripts.bundle:min: npm run compile && npm run build && remodel run ci/bundle.lua public/latest.lua v1.1.4 minify
